family.description: Domain observed N-terminal to the pPIWI_RE domain module. PIWI/Argonaute modules are typically N-terminally fused to the PTND1 and PTND2 domains [[cite:PUB00091015]], pPIWI_RE_X may represent an ancestral version of these domains or represent a N-terminal innovation predating the emergence of PTND1 and PTND2 [[cite:PUB00091016]].
family.name: pPIWI_RE module N-terminal domain
